Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. Answers below and attached an updated quote (Okta_Renewal_Quote_2026_v1.pdf) that includes the bundle credit and a DocuSign link if you want to route electronically.

1) SOC2 scope: Device Posture is covered under our infrastructure and platform services in the SOC2 report we provided. See page 6 for service mapping.
2) Device telemetry: OKTA collects the following posture telemetry by default: device_id_hash, posture_status (compliant/non-compliant), os_family, os_version, last_seen_timestamp. We do not collect device owner full name or email via the posture agent. We can provide a redaction spec for any additional fields.
3) Audit logs: We retain admin/auth events for 18 months by default. We can configure exports to an S3 bucket with a delivery cadence of 24 hours; that will be part of the managed-exports add-on (line-item on the quote).
4) Vulnerability SLA: Posture agent patches follow our quarterly maintenance cycle; critical security fixes are pushed as needed with a 72-hour mitigation SLA. We can provide a CVE tracker snapshot on request.

If that aligns, the commercial path would be: sign the 12-month renewal with the posture add-on and managed exports. Bundle credit applied. If you'd like, I can hold pricing for 30 days to allow PO/legal review. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/RDW-OKTA-2026-001 (link)

Let me know if you'd like a 30-minute call to walk through the telemetry fields or retention configuration.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Strategic Renewals — Okta
